title.en: Waters writes the thesis, Gilmour plays one bend
title.zh: Waters 写论文，Gilmour 一个推音

summary.en: Forty minutes on war, systems, and Dad—then one guitar phrase ends the debate.
summary.zh: 四十分钟二战、制度与爸爸——然后一句吉他推音结束辩论。

body.en:
Roger Waters builds concept-album architecture and spoken-word rage. David Gilmour answers with tone, sustain, and a bend that makes stadiums go quiet.

Floyd fans pick a side the way football fans pick a club. The joke works because both halves are on the same records.
body.zh:
Roger Waters 盖概念专建筑和说唱怒气。David Gilmour 用音色、延音和一个推音让体育馆安静。

Floyd 粉选边，像球迷选俱乐部。笑话成立，是因为两半都在同一张碟上。

note.en: The split is the lore; the solos are the receipt.
note.zh: 分裂是传说；Solo 是小票。
